name: generate_document
description: Export mission findings as a formatted document file (Markdown, CSV, or HTML). Use this when asked to export, download, or share a report. Produces a file in missions/ that the server can stream back to the user.

title.description: Document title shown as the H1 / page title.

format.description: 'md' for Markdown, 'csv' for comma-separated values, 'html' for a styled HTML page.

sections.description: Ordered list of content sections to include.

heading.description: Section heading (becomes H2 in md/html, sheet name prefix in csv).

content.description: Section body text — prose, bullet points, or a short summary.

table.description: Optional tabular data to render under this section.

rows.description: Array of row arrays. Each inner array must have the same length as headers.
